title: CafeBazaar CLI Project Configuration (.bazaar.yaml)
description: Non-secret per-repository settings for bazaar (github.com/PapaDanielVi/cafebazaar_cli). Never store API tokens in this file.

app.description: Default CafeBazaar Android package name (applicationId) or registered app alias used when no variant-specific override matches.

module.description: Default Gradle Android application module path.

default_variant.description: Default Android build variant used by bazaar publish and bazaar android commands.

apps.description: Optional mapping from Android build variant names to CafeBazaar package names or registered aliases.

proxy.description: Proxy URL for CafeBazaar API requests and uploads (http://, https://, socks5://, socks5h://), or 'direct' / 'none' to bypass system proxy environment variables.

tag_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to versionName when bazaar publish creates an annotated Git tag.

commit_template.description: Go fmt.Sprintf template for automated Gradle version bump commit messages. Receives (versionName, versionCode).

auto_publish.description: When true, CafeBazaar publishes the release automatically after review approval instead of waiting for manual publication in Pishkhan.

staged_rollout.description: Default staged rollout percentage (1 to 100) for CafeBazaar gradual rollout (A/B testing). Values below 100 also mark staged rollout as enabled.

staged_rollout_enabled.description: Marks this app as using CafeBazaar staged rollout so interactive bazaar publish prompts for a rollout percentage even before an existing staged release is detected.

bundle_signer_cmd.description: Shell command template run to generate a CafeBazaar Bundle Signer .bin file after building an AAB. {aab} is replaced with the built AAB file path.
